intent.instructions: What shopping action should the assistant perform?

criteria.product_search: search products, looking for phones or laptops or accessories, under budget, price check, find items, show products
criteria.product_details: tell me about this product, tell about it, tell me more, specifications, specs, features, details, product info
criteria.recommendation: suggest a good phone, recommend, advice for gaming, best options
criteria.add_to_cart: explicitly add to cart, put item in my cart, add to my cart, buy this
criteria.cart_action: what is in my cart, view cart, checkout, show cart items, cart total, how much is my cart
criteria.general_query: hello, hi, greetings, thank you, thanks, okay, great, nice, got it, return policy, delivery, customer support

needs_escalation.instructions: Does this query require human support escalation?
